scope: Croatia medical discovery — University of Split School of Medicine

verifiedFacts.claim: University of Split's Medical Studies in English is a six-year integrated programme awarding Doctor of Medicine (MD).

The 2026–27 English Medicine call provides 70 places, EUR 12,000 annual tuition, EUR 200 non-refundable application fee, six-year duration, a 1 July 2026 application deadline, and English-language proof requirements unless prior education was in English or English is the applicant's mother tongue.
The School's English curriculum page says the programme implements requirements of Croatia's regulated-professions law for medical-doctor training.

holdReasons: The School states it is undergoing a re-accreditation procedure, so a complete current independent accreditation decision was not established.
A complete current clinical-placement, accommodation and international student-support evidence packet was not completed.
The public call requires a central admission-portal registration, but a complete verification of international portal procedure and document recognition was not completed.
nextAction: Verify final current reaccreditation status and complete authoritative clinical, accommodation, international-admissions portal and student-support evidence before packaging.
